name: Register with Password
summary: Completes password-based registration from an anonymous entry state through verified email ownership, profile and credential establishment, durable-user creation, home-workspace creation, and an authenticated session.

completionPredicate.expression: durable-identity == resolved and email-ownership == verified and profile-completeness == complete and credential-proof == password-proved and home-workspace == established and session-capability == authenticated-normal

coverageAssessment.rationale: The existing password-registration journey already decomposes the successful activity into explicit atomic scenarios and includes a replay rejection case.
knownGaps: Additional rejected outcomes such as weak password, duplicate durable identity, and workspace provisioning failure remain to be cataloged.
